finding.claim: The /preview endpoint fetches a caller-supplied URL server-side with no validation. An attacker can make the server request internal services, cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254) or localhost. The first 500 characters of the response body and the status code are returned, so this is a full-read SSRF.
finding.source: Query parameter `url` of GET /preview (request.args.get at app.py:15), controlled by any unauthenticated HTTP client
finding.sink: requests.get(target, timeout=5) at app.py:16; the response is returned at app.py:17

trace.note: target = request.args.get('url', '') takes the attacker-controlled URL
target is passed unchanged to requests.get, which follows redirects by default
resp.status_code and resp.text[:500] are returned to the attacker

finding.guards_checked: No scheme check, host allowlist, IP or private-range block, or auth decorator. The ALLOWED_HOSTS check used by /partner is not applied here. The only control is a 5-second timeout, which does not limit the target.
finding.repro: GET /preview?url=http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ returns the metadata response body.

verdict.reason: app.py:15 reads the unauthenticated `url` query param and passes it unchanged to requests.get at app.py:16, with no auth decorator or host/scheme check (the ALLOWED_HOSTS check exists only in /partner at app.py:24), and app.py:17 returns the status code and the first 500 characters of the body.
